assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied ordinary door sprite. Redraw as a SMALL INSET DOOR OVERLAY for a pixel-art game, on a genuinely transparent SQUARE canvas. This overlay will be composited onto an existing east-west wall face; DO NOT include wall masonry, wall coping, wall header, floor, background, or cast shadow. Native32x32 tile composition: door assembly occupies approximately x6..25,y7..29, leaving clear transparent margins on LEFT, RIGHT and ABOVE and a little below. One compact worn gray-green wooden closed door leaf with a tiny dull brass handle, surrounded by an inverted-U frame: two narrow side jambs and one top lintel, all the SAME slender thickness (about2 logical pixels). NO thick horizontal wall-cap slab, NO broad stone pillars, NO bottom frame bar. Frame is muted khaki stone, same material and thickness all three sides. Door height visibly LESS than one tile. Fixed high75degree downward orthographic game camera; restrained flat architectural front face with a tiny top surface, NO diagonal isometric distortion, no vanishing point. Upper-left light, dark sage wood, charcoal outlines, hard coarse pixel clusters suitable for32px,16 restrained colors. No text or markings. Keep entire outside of the small inverted-U doorway truly transparent. Only one asset.

The complete interior from just below lintel down to canvas bottom MUST be genuinely transparent, as must all exterior margins. No swung-open leaf, no floor, no black fill, no bottom frame bar. Absolutely just an empty U-shaped frame. Invariants: identical fixed high-angle orthographic camera, same outline/position/scale, same clear margins on left/right/top/bottom, height less than one native32px tile, muted olive/khaki palette, upper-left light, hard coarse pixel clusters, no cast shadow no wall no background no text. Keep genuine alpha transparency.
